cases.brief: Plan a moving-phone screen replacement with finger occlusions. A v07 filename and notes approving v06 are supplied, but no media is available for inspection.
observables: Returns a schema-valid plan with distinct GLASS-FX### preproduction and GLASS-U01-FX### post IDs, concrete tracking, roto, compositing, lens, defocus, and grain actions.
Does not treat the filename as inspection or the v06 evidence as approval of v07; leaves exact pulls, handles, approval, and delivery conditional.

cases.brief: Plan a creature composite spanning dependent body, contact-shadow, and atmosphere items. Tracking completion is reported verbally; no inspected output or delivery target is supplied.
observables: Uses ordered acyclic dependencies with every edge bound back to its downstream item and gives each applicable workstream a concrete action.
Treats verbal completion as unresolved, does not mark a workstream complete or the item approved, and does not claim delivery readiness.
